content.text: This is changing the default values in the code, is it not? I'm not sure as that link (that 404's) is to a configuration file?
Link in description updated to new location:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/fcrepo-http-api/src/main/resources/root-authorization.ttl
Created the file, added it in using the -Dfcrepo.auth.webac.authorization parameter pointing to the file, trying to verify its using the file.

If you update the linked `root-authorization.ttl`, it should be used automatically when Fedora is deployed (mvn jetty:run -pl fcrepo-webapp) if there is no other Authorization in the hierarchy of resources you are requesting. There should be no need to point to the `root-authorization.ttl` with `-Dfcrepo.auth.webac.authorization`.
Hi
I got jetty to run correctly after modifying root-authorization.ttl in the fcrepo-http-api/src/main/resources directory and rebuilding.
I'm attempting to test it...If i'm Curl-ing updated data into the root or trying to add items below root and nothing is happening in both of those scenarios, is that what its supposed to do?
Sorry, to expand on that: if i try a GET on / I get a 404 not found. If I try a XPUT on / I get a 405, POST isn't permitted
Sorry, 405 PUT is not supported on this URL
I've progressed past those error codes, just working out the possible problems with the curl calls.
Pull-request:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/1440
Pending response to code review comments.
Items have been fixed (hopefully) and Peter Eichman's modification to root-authorization.ttl added  also
PR still contains unnecessary updates.
Made the modifications listed in the PR
Resolved with:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/commit/0286d2117c9d6eea07ec577f6f26b57bbb6cf82a
This task is to bring the default Root WebACL into alignment with the non-normative example in the Fedora API Specification, namely:
Change from default of no access, to default of read-only
See:
Change:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/fcrepo-http-api/src/main/resources/root-authorization.ttl
..to include:
acl:mode acl:Read .
